title: Concept: Pubspec with an unconstrained SDK range
description: pubspec.yaml declares an `environment.sdk` value of `any`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `environment.sdk` value of `any`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pubspec.yaml (pub).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `environment.sdk` value of `any`.
